import gdsfactory as gf

r = gf.Component()

# Create MZI with specified parameters
mzi_component = gf.components.mzi(delta_length=10.0, length_y=10.0)

# Add MZI to circuit and position at origin
mzi_ref = r.add_ref(mzi_component)
mzi_ref.move((0, 0))

# Expose input and output ports
r.add_port('o1', port=mzi_ref.ports['o1'])
r.add_port('o2', port=mzi_ref.ports['o2'])

# Draw ports and plot
r.draw_ports()
r.plot()
